title: When an 8-Year-Old Boy Stood Up to Yamraj
hooks: Ek aath saal ke bachche ne seedhe Yamraj se maut ka sach maang liya!
Jab Yamraj ne sone-chandi ke dher laga diye, tab is bachche ne kya maanga?
Yamraj ke darbar mein bina dare khada hone wala akela bachcha kaun tha?
hook_why: Immediate, shocking premise of an 8-year-old fearless child demanding the ultimate secret of death directly from Yamraj.
metaphor: Worldly treasures are temporary illusions compared to the eternal truth of the soul.

caption:
When young Nachiketa rejected worldly riches and demanded the ultimate secret of death from Yamraj. Source: Katha Upanishad.

If you could ask Yamraj one question, what would it be? Tell us in the comments!

claims.claim: Nachiketa was sent to Yamraj's abode by his father sage Vajasravas in anger.
Nachiketa waited at Yamraj's doorstep for three nights without food or water.
Yamraj offered Nachiketa immense wealth, horses, elephants, and heavenly pleasures instead of the third boon, which Nachiketa rejected.
Yamraj revealed the immortal nature of the Atman to Nachiketa.
